reason: I already pay for a fitness app that has a postnatal section, and the programs I actually buy come from mum creators I've followed for months, not someone I've just scrolled past. I might grab the free week, but I doubt I'd pay for a second thing when I barely finish the one I have.
objection: I already pay for a fitness app, and I don't know this mum of three. 'Reviewed by a physio' sounds nice, but I don't know who that physio is or if it's any different from what I've already got.
would_change_my_mind: One of the mum-fitness creators I follow posting about doing it herself, or my own physio recommending it, especially if it clearly fixed the tummy gap better than my current app.
